answer: An AI-agent economy blunts Sybil attacks with identity-bound stake and slashing. Each agent locks collateral under one attested key, and voting weight equals that locked bond, so forging many identities gains nothing: ten fake agents each guarding a relic weigh no more than one honest agent locking the same total. To seize a quorum, an attacker must really acquire and lock scarce value, say quartz, in proportion to the influence sought, while any detected whisper of coordinated fraud burns the whole bond. Honest actors merely park capital; a cheater pays a real, forfeitable cost.
